name: Dashboard stat tiles and a call-volume chart
looks: Four stat tiles roll up their numbers side by side, each with a small captioned change beneath it. Below them an area chart of call volume draws itself across the month, and a short call-log table fills in with rows of phone numbers, durations and a coloured sentiment tag per row.
build: data-infographic drives all three: the tiles' digits roll up under a speed-linked blur, the area chart draws left to right with a filled gradient beneath the line, and the log rows stagger in on a quick 0.05s beat with their sentiment tag popping in last.
sound: A rising tone under the tile roll-ups, a soft whoosh under the chart draw, and a light tick per log row.
prompt: Prove the product is measurable: roll up a row of headline stat tiles with their period-over-period change, draw a volume chart across the month beneath them, and fill in a short log of individual records, each tagged with its own outcome.
